(b) R4's verified_by does not name Amendment 1 as undischarged. The added guard fails closed, so the missing test can only hide a false refusal, never a wrong count in an artifact. R1.ruling: discharged (code and docstring); test clause not delivered (N-A)
R1.basis: certification_run.py:524 count_gold_reads counts over set(gold_used). It raises SealedRoleError for any role other than certification, including documents missing from the role map (mapped to 'unknown'). It raises RuntimeError when the certification count differs from expected_documents. cli.py:805 passes access_log.document_count, the len(sorted(groups)) from cli.py:752, and runs before the artifact is built or written. Equality holds on consistent inputs: the preflight coverage check (certification_preflight.py, 'missing' branch) requires every role-map certification document to be predicted identically by zs/fs/qa, and parse_arm emits one PredictionRecord per distinct instance_key. So distinct gold reads = 3,152 = access-log count, matching certification_result.json documents_read 3152 and the retrospective's certification_documents. The docstring says the non-certification zero holds by construction of the filter (R1 clause 3). Unit tests for all four branches are in tests/test_certify_hardening.py:165-182. Not delivered: the required 'CLI test with a monkeypatched archive that pins the counts'. The CLI tests still stop at the archive guard (test_consistent_inputs_reach_the_archive_only_after_the_preflight), so the cli.py:805 wiring is checked by inspection only. CX-SEALED-01 limitation 3 (claim_ledger.json:240) ends 'The command now counts the gold it uses, by role', which does not repeat that the final/shift zero is still by construction (N-B).

R2.basis: certification_preflight.py:221-225 recomputes grid_hash_from_certifiable_thresholds(system_id, thresholds) and refuses on mismatch with the grid's declared hash. That hash is separately required to equal the frozen manifest's, so the thresholds certify uses (cli.py reads the same certifiable_thresholds) are now transitively bound to the frozen hash. threshold_grid.py:157 rebuilds the candidate tuple build_threshold_grid hashes; the extraction into _hash_candidates changes no behaviour. Tests: test_thresholds_that_do_not_hash_to_the_declared_grid_refuse (edited thresholds, untouched hash, as R2 asked) and test_the_committed_grids_hash_to_their_declared_hashes (all three committed grids reproduce). Both pass; test_threshold_grid.py passes (10).

R3.basis: CX-STRATIFICATION-01 method and limitation 1 now describe the oracle-accepted set as the largest best-scoring prefix whose running risk stays within the target, with a label-chosen cut-off, 'not a ranking by true loss'. This matches risk_coverage_frontier (certification_run.py:328-356: sorted by score, last index with running_risk <= alpha). The appendix is regenerated; test_claims.py passes.
